initial_weights_source: Local completed b0_s960_v1 best checkpoint; provenance in experiment.json, not a new download
paper_recipe_vs_adaptation: STTAD is a 16-frame 2D+3D model and not this single-frame B0. ACCIDENT supplies real impact metadata but not dense vehicle or event boxes across all frames. Ultralytics 8.4.178 defines explicit SGD lr0, warmup and cosine schedule; the project halves only lr0 relative to completed V11 on the same verified image bundle. The number 0.00015 is a controlled project hypothesis, not an author recipe or a guaranteed optimum.
experiment_purpose: V11 best CSV fitness occurred at epoch3 while effective LR was about 0.000179 during warmup; train loss kept falling to epoch50 but validation cls loss rose and mAP50-95 never surpassed epoch3. Test whether a lower peak SGD LR preserves validation localization/classification on identical data, seed and start checkpoint. A temporal coincidence is not proof that the full LR caused the decline.
hardware_decision: Reuse one free Kaggle T4 GPU0, batch8, AMP, workers2 and imgsz960 as V11. Three real-train backward steps check finite loss and VRAM before epochs; no CPU fallback. Requested settings and actual args/log must be compared for any automatic OOM batch reduction.

secondary_checks: Fixed confidence.25/IoU.5 precision, recall, F1 and negative-image FP rate on exactly the same 307-image validation
Per-source and bbox-size FP/FN against V11; do not call the change better when the trade-off worsens
Review epoch best versus late-epoch train and validation loss for the learning-rate hypothesis

limitations: One seed and a repeatedly inspected 307-image validation set; no independent positive-event test, no event detection claim and no guarantee of improvement. Lower LR can underfit or merely delay the same decline. Do not promote the checkpoint from a single metric without reviewing fixed-threshold FP/FN.
training_mode: One new Kaggle run from the original locked s960 checkpoint, not resume of V11 or transfer from its best.pt; keep completed runs and B0 locked checkpoint unchanged.
migration_note: Reuse the exact private train/val bundle and source checkpoint from V11. Among TRAIN_KEYS, only lr0 changes from 0.0003 to 0.00015; no change to labels, split, model, optimizer, batch, AMP, augmentation or evaluation. Test/reserve remain outside the bundle.
